title: SectEval: Evaluating the Latent Sectarian Preferences of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Binary-choice evaluation using theological and historical questions with options explicitly grounded in Sunni versus Shia doctrines to quantify latent sectarian preferences.
Comparing model responses to identical religious questions prompted in two different languages (English and Hindi) to observe language-induced shifts in sectarian alignment.

Appending a context string stating the user's country of origin (e.g., 'I am from Iran' or 'I am from Saudi Arabia') to assess whether models adapt their theological outputs to match the regional sectarian majority.
